metadata.task: Candidate list of major/minor HEOR vendors from ISPOR 2026 attendee sheet plus ISPOR/AMCP 2026 exhibitor review.
metadata.classification_rule: major = large/well-established HEOR, RWE, market access, CRO, data, or analytics platform with broad market presence; minor = specialist, emerging, regional, niche software/data, or lower-volume candidate.
notes: Vendor backbone was built from the attendee workbook Affiliation/Affiliation short name columns, official ISPOR 2026 exhibitor directory, AMCP 2026 materials, and HEOR market knowledge.
AI capabilities were recorded only where a direct vendor website page was identified and captured in Chrome.
Vendors without direct AI evidence remain in the JSON with an empty ai_capabilities list.
